setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays pattern 1 on the example MIDI device, the four-note melody C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) on steps 1 to 4. The additions of the Foundation phrase on steps 5 and 7 do not exist yet; you add them in the next step. No Harmony Ensemble group exists and Structure markers are off, so every note plays as written. The norns shows the Device page and the grid lights steps 1 to 4.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Hold step 1 (1,4) and tap step 8 (8,4) to loop eight steps. Open the pattern page (5,8), choose pattern 2 (2,1), tap trigs on steps 5 and 7, return to Channel (3,8) and assign pattern 2 (2,2). Then open Channel tasks > Harmony and choose Ensemble. The header reads ENSEMBLE CH01.
steps.title: Add the additions, open Ensemble

steps.caption: On the Ensemble list choose Create group and press K3 to make group 1. Select Template count with E2 and turn E3 to 3: the group's chord has three tones.
steps.title: Make the chord three notes

steps.caption: Select Tone 2 with E2 and turn E3 to 2, two scale degrees above the root, which is E in C major.
steps.title: Set Tone 2

steps.caption: Select Tone 3 with E2 and turn E3 to 4, four scale degrees above the root, which is G. The chord is now C, E and G.
steps.title: Set Tone 3

steps.caption: Press K3 to apply: the footer reads APPLIED.
steps.title: Apply the chord

steps.caption: Press K2 to return to the Ensemble list, select Members and press K3. The header reads MEMBERS CH01: the list of channels that follow the group's chord.
steps.title: Open Members

steps.caption: Set Group enabled to On with E3 and press K3. Voice count reads 1: channel 1, the only member, carries the chord on its own. The footer reads APPLIED.
steps.title: Switch the group on

steps.caption: Open Channel tasks > Merge modes. Select Strategy with E2 and turn E3 to FOUNDATION. This accepted strategy applies immediately while stopped, without K3. On Merge modes, Strategy and Active read FOUNDATION, so the four anchors on steps 1 to 4 plus the additions on steps 5 and 7 now play.
steps.title: Turn Foundation on

steps.caption: Open Merge Shape > Pitch, then choose Structure. Structure snaps chosen moments of the Foundation line to a chord while the notes in between keep their own pitch.
steps.title: Open Structure

steps.caption: Turn E3 once to set Markers to ANCHORS: every anchor onset now counts as a marker.
steps.title: Markers on anchors

steps.caption: A Chord group row appears showing 1, the Ensemble group you made. Structure needs an enabled group before Apply will accept the markers.
steps.title: Chord group one appears

steps.caption: Press K3 to apply, then tap Play. Each anchor note snaps to the nearest chord tone, and a note exactly between two chord tones snaps to the lower one. Step 1 stays at 60, step 2 moves from 62 to 60, step 3 stays at 64 and step 4 moves from 65 to 64: the loop plays MIDI 60, 60, 64, 64 in the strip below. The added notes on steps 5 and 7 keep their own pitch and accent. Tap Play to stop.
steps.title: Anchors snap to the chord

steps.caption: Open Channel tasks > Harmony > Ensemble and choose Delete group for group 1. A confirmation opens before anything is deleted; its Affected row reads 1, naming channel 1 as the channel that uses the group.
steps.title: Check who deletion affects

steps.caption: Press K3 to confirm. Deleting the group also sets Markers to OFF in the same change. Tap Play: the anchors return to their written pitches, MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65, and the added notes on steps 5 and 7 are unchanged. Tap Play to stop.
steps.title: Deletion restores authored pitches

title: Snap Foundation anchors to a chord
